verdict.rationale: Baseten's docs show some portability elements — training checkpoints are synced to external storage and models are packaged via the open-source Truss format with a plain config.yaml (baseten-docs-14, baseten-docs-28, baseten-gh-1, baseten-gh-2) — but there is no documented feature for bulk export of workspace data, logs, or account content, nor any 'leave the platform' workflow. missing for 10: an explicit data-export/download feature, an account-closure or data-portability guarantee, and independent confirmation that exported models/checkpoints are usable elsewhere without Baseten-specific tooling.
